pos.personaBrief: Gallardo stated a team must have the ball and attack to win; sources describe a dominating possession side with about 36 positional attacks per game and only about 3 counter chances.

pro.personaBrief: Coaches' Voice: short precise passes from defence and a gradual build through the thirds, though with changes of pace; River also pressed high so opponents could not play out.

est.personaBrief: Tactical variability across many shapes and flexible drawings suggests fluid, relational roles with a striker like Pratto linking play, yet a clear collective model with defined phases.

lar.personaBrief: He used 4-3-1-2 and 4-3-2-1 without classic wingers, then added width through back-three wing-backs in 2017; the width came from carrileros and full-backs rather than touchline wingers.

blo.personaBrief: Bielsa-style high pressing, advanced pressing, counter-pressing and quick recovery runs; in the 2019 final the high press suffocated Flamengo's build-up.

mar.personaBrief: No marking evidence in the sources; a modern high-line pressing side with compact central numbers is most consistent with zonal principles, without a dedicated man-marker pattern.

pla.personaBrief: He kept an own identity ('jugamos de la manera que nos representa', keep attacking when games open) but varied shapes with the squad and opponent, and tested a back three against Boca.

res.personaBrief: Stated mission to attack and dominate, preferring the risk of playing his way; but he won titles and added a centre-back late in the 2019 final only reactively.

sis.personaBrief: A strong collective model and unity ('everyone defends a cause') with stars like Pity Martinez and D'Alessandro in defined roles, yet he trusted his playmaker through criticism.

jog.personaBrief: Technical, possession-based team with creative playmakers (D'Alessandro, Quintero, Pity) alongside pressing intensity; build-up favours passing midfielders over pure physicality.

bas.personaBrief: He gave debuts to academy players (Boye, Driussi, Mammana, Montiel, Palacios) and sold them for profit, but also signed experienced figures (Pratto, Armani, D'Alessandro, Pinola, Maidana).

lid.personaBrief: D'Onofrio praised him for forming excellent groups and he stressed unity and everyone feeling important, but he also admitted breaking a rule and takes responsibility; a firm but collective leader.
